overview.about: The ICC Men's T20 World Cup is the shortest and most explosive form of international cricket's world championship, packing big hitting and huge crowds into three-hour matches. It has spread the game to new audiences and produced some of cricket's most dramatic finishes. India, England and West Indies have each won it twice. The 2028 tournament is hosted by Australia.
overview.nextEvent: The 2028 ICC Men's T20 World Cup is hosted by Australia, with the Melbourne Cricket Ground among the venues. The 20-over format compresses a match into an evening and makes upsets far more likely than in the 50-over game.
